Apartment

Comfortable Ski Retreat

  • Bulgaria

  • Pirin Mountains

  • Bansko

  • 1-5 persons

  • 1 bedroom

  • 1 bathroom

  • Pets not allowed

Cozy, cozy ski apartment in Bansko, Bulgaria

Just a 4-minute walk from the ski lift, this elegant and cosy apartment offers a stylish place to relax for couples, friends or families.

Enjoy relaxing evenings with board games and puzzles, stay connected with fast and reliable Wi-Fi for work or streaming, get outside with the sled, take thermos jugs with you on your mountain adventures and unwind under the rain shower after an active day in nature.

The apartment can comfortably accommodate up to 4 guests, with space for one additional child who can sleep in the camp bed.

This two-room apartment features:

  • Fast Wi-Fi, ideal for remote working and streaming
  • A spacious living and dining room, a separate bedroom and a modern bathroom

Bedroom

  • A 160 × 200 cm bed with a brand new mattress topper
  • Blackout curtains for a good night's sleep
  • Two bedside tables and a large wardrobe

Living space

  • New sofa bed that converts into a comfortable double bed with mattress topper (120 × 200 cm)
  • Extra single trundle bed available on request with mattress topper (90 × 200 cm)
  • Smart TV with all the popular streaming apps
  • Board games and puzzles (Exploding Kittens, Rummikub, Uno, Ludo, Memory & more)

Family-friendly

  • Camping cot, high chair and baby bath available on request

Kitchen & dining area

  • Fully equipped kitchen for real cooking
  • Dolce Gusto coffee machine, French press, toaster, hand blender
  • Fridge with freezer, hob, cooking utensils, crockery, wine and beer glasses
  • Dining table with four comfortable chairs

Bathroom

  • Rain shower
  • Extra-large fluffy towels and comfortable bathrobes

Outside

  • Balcony with a beautiful view of the mountains on the right

Guidelines for reviews

We find reviews very important, both the positive and the negative. When evaluating your stay in a holiday home, we ask that you to take the following guidelines into account:


Reviews should be about the rented holiday home
The most useful reviews are detailed and help others make better decisions. We ask you to simply review the holiday home and leave other things out of the review.

Respect the privacy of others
Do not include email addresses, phone numbers, websites, social media accounts, and similar information from others in your review.

Reviews must be respectful
We expect you to write respectful reviews and keep it clean.

The following is not allowed:

  • A review that is obscene, defamatory, threatening, harmful or discriminatory
  • Political, religious or social commentary
  • Advertising or other commercial content

Reviews that do not comply with our guidelines can be removed and will no longer be included in the average grade.

Review niet afkomstig vanuit een Micazu boeking

Some of our hosts have not yet received any, or only a few, reviews from renters who booked via Micazu. To still provide you with sufficient information about the accommodation, they have the option to have a few reviews written by renters who have previously stayed in the accommodation but booked their stay via another channel. These submitted reviews are monitored by us. Do you doubt whether a review meets our guidelines? Then you can report it here.
